To this end, I have created a comprehensive system built upon a core philosophy of Procedural Realism. 57fa7643-5798-4406-82c1-9862fa9b54f8.text: 🎉 Disproof #176: Written on the Wall conjecture 892 (Fajtlowicz, June 1996, 30 years open) is FALSE. It claims that for a cubic triangle-free graph, the blue clique number is at least the number of components of a minimum spanning set. Two famous graphs break it: three independent edges totally dominate the Franklin graph (n=12) and the Heawood graph (n=14), yet neither contains three vertices that are pairwise at distance 3 — so 3 > 2. k disjoint Heawood copies give margin k, so the failure is unbounded. Honest caveat, written into the section: the author's own fallback "weakest interpretation" survives, and on my evidence is probably true. Franklin is the unique counterexample among the 22 cubic triangle-free graphs of order 12; orders 16 and 18 are entirely clean. Verifier EXIT 0, 585 assertions: [link to gitlab.com — details withheld]
